visible_text: Help me write a short, polite email to my landlord about a leaking kitchen faucet. Ask if someone can repair it this week.
Subject: Leaking Kitchen Faucet - Request for Repair
Dear Landlord,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm writing to let you know that the kitchen faucet in my unit has been leaking for a few days. The dripping is becoming quite noticeable, and I wanted to bring it to your attention as soon as possible.
Could someone please schedule a repair for this week? I'm happy to be available at a time that works best for you.
Thank you for your help and I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Best regards,
[Your Name] [Your Unit/Apartment Number]

visible_text: Write a short cover letter for a junior graphic designer applying to a small design studio. Use placeholders for the company and my name.

Subject: Junior Graphic Designer Application – [Your Name]
Dear Hiring Team at [Company Name],
I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Junior Graphic Designer position at [Company Name]. As a passionate and creative designer with a strong foundation in visual communication, I am eager to contribute my skills to your team's innovative projects.
Throughout my time studying [or working] at [Your Institution/Previous Company], I have honed my abilities in [mention 1-2 key skills, e.g., typography, branding, print media], using tools such as [mention 1-2 software, e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Figma]. I am particularly drawn to [Company Name]’s work in [mention something specific about the company/industry], and I am excited about the opportunity to grow alongside a talented team.
I would love the chance to discuss how my enthusiasm and design skills can contribute to [Company Name]’s upcoming projects. Thank you for your time and consideration—I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Sincerely,
[Your Name]

Create a simple packing checklist for a weekend trip. Include clothing, toiletries, and travel documents.
Here’s a simple weekend trip packing checklist:

🧳 Clothing
•	2–3 T-shirts or casual tops
•	1 pair of pants/jeans
•	1 sweater or light jacket (for evening cool)
•	1 pair of socks
•	Sleepwear
•	Comfortable walking shoes or sneakers

🧴 Toiletries
•	Toothbrush & toothpaste
•	Deodorant
•	Shampoo, conditioner (if you forget at the hotel)
•	Body wash or bar soap
•	Lip balm
•	Sunscreen (if going outdoors)
•	Basic first aid: band-aids, pain reliever

🪪 Travel Documents
•	ID or passport (depending on destination)
•	Driver’s license (if driving)
•	Reservation confirmations (hotel, activity tickets, etc.)
•	Payment cards or a small amount of cash
•	Phone charger & power bank
•	Any tickets to events or activities

🎒 Extras
•	Reusable water bottle
•	Snacks (in case of long drives)
•	Portable phone charger or power bank
Let me know your destination or trip type (beach, mountains, city, etc.) for a more tailored list!
